column1: # Heap+inject campaign costs: the seed and fallback of tools/corpus part sizing (sync.py NATIVE_HEAP_COSTS).
# Runs measure their own costs into the git common directory's hirsel-heap-costs.tsv (a row a `case@K`, current
# while its case file and the std store sources are unchanged), and a run with a current row is sized from it;
# a run without one probes first. These rows give --plan its estimates and round one its site bound.
# One row each, tab-separated: key (a case, or a prefix of run ids), sites (of the measured run), seconds a
# site (from a pool run's ledger rows, the worst quarter of the site range; else part wall minus clean wall
# over the part's sites, local --jobs 1), clean seconds (the clean run alone; for a local row, that run's
# worst, 106, for a STORE-11 family, and the largest measured, 150.56, for a larger case), and a note naming
# the sample. A run takes its longest matching key; with none, the worst figures of its rule, else the worst
